_comment: ZhiGui MCP Server cross-platform config template — copy the config for your tool and replace <skill_directory> with the actual absolute path

trae._config_file: Trae Settings > MCP > Add > Manual Add
trae._note: In Trae: Settings > MCP > Add > Manual Add, then paste the JSON. If 'node' is not on PATH, use the absolute path to node.exe (forward slashes recommended).

generic_mcp._note: Standard MCP stdio config — works with any MCP-compatible AI tool. Refer to your tool's docs for where to paste this.

_tips: 1. If 'node' is not on PATH, replace "node" with the absolute path to your node.exe (use forward slashes, e.g. C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe). Paths with spaces may fail in some tools — prefer a space-free path.
2. In JSON, backslashes must be doubled (\\), or simply use forward slashes (/).
3. No env block needed — the engine auto-detects its data directory.
4. The dashboard server (port 7788) does not need to be running for MCP to work.
5. The MCP Server reads/writes JSON files directly; the dashboard auto-refreshes via fs.watch.
